title: Rust trust-anchor store + /.well-known/trust-anchors resource (port of Python viku.2)
description: Follow-up from viku.2 (Python reference landed). Port TrustAnchorStore + TrustAnchorsResource to rust/lichen-gateway: same semantics — anchors keyed by issuer IID, raw Ed25519 or X.509 DER CA certs (x509-cert crate), cross-signed = same-key cert attachment (kind flip raw->x509), provisioned anchors immutable-but-cert-extendable, bounds MAX_ANCHORS=64 / MAX_CERTS_PER_ANCHOR=8 / MAX_CERT_DER_BYTES=1024 / MAX_METADATA_ENTRIES=8 / MAX_METADATA_BYTES=256, GET open + POST/DELETE guarded by injected authorize over OSCORE identity (fail-closed), strict per-path field sets, cert chain validation out of scope (viku.6). Mirror the Python test matrix.
